Identity.History: There are stories from time to time of a Fairy revealing the location of their home to outsiders. Many will flock to these springs in hope of gaining the favor of Fairies, bringing gifts and services as offerings.
Identity.Tooltip: Allows the trading of resources on the market or with your allies. Also allows the Fairies to hire Mercenaries.
